acceptance: The baseline SHA that run 38612765430 compared against is identified, along with why the /results/ captures differed: results data, the merge ref, or the choice of ancestor.

If baseline selection can pick a baseline whose results data differs from the PR's merge base, it is fixed so the comparison uses a baseline that matches the base's results data, or fails with a message naming the stale baseline SHA instead of reporting page changes.
A test covers the stale-baseline case.
No visual tolerance is loosened, and no capture is excluded.

description:
PR #2960 changed only `scripts/publication/check_explorer_compat.py` and its unit test. The "Public-site visual regression" job still failed twice (run 38612765430, attempts 1 and 2, job 116045844509). It reported "visual baseline mismatch" for all 12 /results/, /results/benchmarks/ and /results/platforms/ captures at 390, 768, 1280 and 1600 px. The landing, getting-started and release-overview pages matched.

After the branch was rebased onto develop 6296e0a2d, the job was skipped (render_changed=false) and the PR merged as 478e946de. The rebase removed the symptom, but the cause was never confirmed. The likely cause is that the baseline came from an older site-equivalent ancestor, whose results data differed from the PR's merge ref, rather than from the exact base.
